svg.title: The Ranger's Book 2: two days, a refund and the envelope stubs
svg.desc: The logbook's second spread: two days of check-ins with five rows closed up and a refund line in red that confuses the fee sum. On the right, the cash count beside Tam's pencil working, and the drop-box envelope stubs pinned along the page, each with a licence plate; one plate, ringed in pencil, has no row.
svg.text: numbers hold. 2LW 958: no row. A car in the lot, no site.
